mechanisms.title: Requirements Type Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Schedule line moves quantity. Requirements type explains what that demand means to planning and cost control.
mechanisms.question: Which requirements type and requirements class control this sales demand?
mechanisms.determination: Depending on the configured source, the system determines the requirements type from material planning strategy information or from sales item category + MRP type. If both MRP group and strategy group are maintained for strategy-based determination, the strategy group has precedence.
controls: account-assignment and cost-management behavior from the requirements class
availability-check interaction depending on planning design
configuration_surfaces: Check Control of Requirements Type Determination

failure_modes.symptom: Sales order creates the wrong planning or make-to-order behavior
failure_modes.prove: Trace determination source → strategy/MRP group → requirements type → requirements class before changing schedule-line or production settings.

failure_modes.symptom: Same material behaves differently in another sales process
failure_modes.prove: Compare sales item category and the configured requirements-type source; item category can intentionally make requirements semantics process-dependent.

tests.setup: Use a material with a controlled strategy group, then compare with a material where determination falls back to item category + MRP type.
tests.assert: The sales order receives the expected requirements type and the corresponding requirements-class controls.
